decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is a commoditised service under heavy pressure from Teams and Zoom after the pandemic, and it was not visible on the website in 2020 to 2021, but it still complements the enterprise voice portfolio and is probably kept for one more year.
Metro data centre connectivity is core to the firm's owned fibre and carrier-neutral data centre strategy and has proven adoption in financial hubs.
Optical spectrum services monetise the owned fibre for high-bandwidth customers, which fits the firm's move toward high-capacity infrastructure.
Carrier pre-selection is a shrinking legacy service as networks move to all-IP, but residual revenue and regulatory obligations make full withdrawal within a year less likely than not.
Direct voice network connections support enterprises and service providers moving to SIP and cloud voice, so the service stays relevant.
